lead_raw_text:
The structure of Cu₂AgAuS₄ crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with a unit cell containing 32 atoms and four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ag and Au each coordinated by four S neighbors in tetrahedral motifs, while Cu centers have six S neighbors in an octahedral environment. Corner-sharing is observed between Ag and Cu tetrahedral polyhedra, and between Au and Cu polyhedra, with additional edge-sharing between Cu octahedra. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 32 sites.
